2.name: Nimiq bridge and session
2.note: Work reconstructed from the working tree on 2026-09-03 - the prior session did this work but did not update the tracking files.
done: packages/relay-protocol/src/nimiq-rpc.ts (+test) - first-party plain-fetch JSON-RPC client (getBlockNumber, getTransactionByHash with a typed TransactionNotFoundError), scoped to only the methods the backend tx verifier needs (DECISIONS.md D-001)

packages/relay-protocol/src/nimiq-verify.ts (+test) - pure-JS Nimiq signed-message verification (@noble/ed25519 + @noble/hashes, SHA-256 prefix construction) and Blake2b-256 address derivation, cross-checked byte-for-byte against a golden vector generated from the real @nimiq/core Node build (evidence/testnet/phase2-nimiq-signature-vector.md). Also signNimiqSignedMessage/nimiqPublicKeyFromPrivate for offline tooling + tests (not on the trust path).

packages/relay-protocol/src/verify-transaction.ts (+test) - pure PRD 9.6 decision function verifyHandoffTransaction(tx, expected): sender/recipient/no-self-transfer/value(bigint-exact)/NR1 data commitment(relay+leg+128-bit)/network/inclusion/execution/confirmations -> discriminated ok|fail result, never throws. 18 adversarial cases including cross-relay and cross-leg commitment replay.

apps/worker/src/auth/routes.ts (+test) - Hono sub-app at /api/auth: POST /nonce, POST /verify (zod -> consume nonce -> expiry -> verify signed message -> derive address -> find-or-create player -> device hash -> session -> cookie), POST /logout, GET /me. 12 tests in real workerd (SELF.fetch) incl single-use/replay, expiry, wrong-message signature, forged cookie, full login->me->logout.
apps/worker/src/auth/middleware.ts - requireSession: HMAC gate + store lookup as revocation/expiry authority (PRD 11.6)
apps/worker/src/auth/store.ts (+test) - AuthStore port + InMemoryAuthStore for dev/tests; Supabase impl pending credentials, routes depend only on the interface
apps/worker/src/auth/session.ts (+test) - HMAC-signed opaque session token, HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Lax cookie, 30-day max age, timing-safe compare (PRD 11.6)
apps/worker/src/auth/nonce.ts (+test) - single-use expiring origin-bound login nonce and the exact sign-in message shape (PRD 11.4 / 32.3)
apps/worker/src/auth/device-hash.ts (+test) - HMAC-SHA256 (server pepper) of the Nimiq Pay device identifier; raw value never persisted (PRD 11.5)
apps/worker: env.ts gains APP_ORIGIN; wrangler.jsonc gains a dev/test vars block; index.ts mounts /api/auth; .env.example documents APP_ORIGIN
scripts/verify/nimiq-rpc-spike.ts - live dual-network RPC spike; evidence at evidence/testnet/phase2-nimiq-rpc-spike.log (NIMIQ_RPC_SPIKE_PASS)
DECISIONS.md D-006 - both Nimiq RPC endpoints confirmed by network in both directions

blockers.description: User is providing credentials to a fresh Supabase account (not the CLI-linked account) for the NIM Relay project. Needed to run `supabase link` + `supabase db push` against supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql, closing the last Phase 1 gate item.

Real Nimiq Pay app on a physical phone is required for SDK init, device identifier prompt, account list, sign, sendBasicTransactionWithData, and all real-device acceptance gates (PRD section 39.8). Blocks the Phase 2 gate. Non-device Phase 2 work (auth routes, backend tx verifier) can proceed without it.
Real NIM on MainAlbatross is required to fund the flagship Global Relay baton and run the production smoke relay.
